mech_summary: Wrath of the Wastes turns Whirlwind into a moving Rend applicator — spin through, bleeds tick behind you; the genre's spin-to-win in its set-authored D3 form.
Hammer of the Ancients under Immortal King's permanent Call of the Ancients — big fury-dump smashes with a spectral ancestor squad on retainer; the 'lazy spin-to-win adjacent' comfort king.
Might of the Earth makes LEAP the damage engine — every landing triggers Earthquakes; the movement verb IS the build, three jumps on rotation.

mob.note: GX-01: the D3 flagship of movement-as-damage — Leap Attack's redemption arc vs d2-leap-attack-barb

mech_summary: Furious Charge stacks Raekor power that a max-fury Boulder Toss dumps in one throw — charge to BUILD, hurl to SPEND; gap-closer as generator.
Single-target Frenzy stacking under the S20 Horde set — one button, one target, attack-speed ramp to a blur; D3's late-life answer to the D2 Frenzy lineage.

Zero-damage support barbarian — globe vacuuming with Ignore Pain and Threatening Shout uptime, pulling packs into kill zones for the trash-killer; one quarter of the professionalized 4-player GR meta.
Condemn charges a nova around the body that Blade of Prophecy detonates instantly — perma-Akarat's-Champion angel-mode saders erasing screens in expanding rings.
Damage BY being hit — Invoker converts the Thorns stat into the whole offense; stand in the crowd, punish every swing against you; the defense-stat-as-weapon archetype.
Aegis of Valor's holy lightning bolts from heaven — the D2 FoHdin homage as a D3 set, ranged smiting with Heaven's Fury beam swaps; the buff-rebirth crusader flagship.
Legacy of Nightmares ancient-item stacking turns Bombardment's off-screen boulder barrage into a one-cooldown build — ride Norvald's charge loop, rain rocks; the setless-archetype poster child.

canonicity.fame: high — 'Diablo II Hammerdin homage' per current lists

mech_summary: Seeker of the Light resurrects the spiral-orbiter — Blessed Hammers circling out from the cast point with Falling Sword resets; the Hammerdin lineage's official D3 chapter.
Sweep Attack spam under Roland's attack-speed engine — launched weak, buffed into brief S17 relevance, and now explicitly 'not recommended' in S39 lists; a full weak-reborn-faded arc in one set.
Discipline-stacked Multishot fans erasing whole screens per click — the fastest map-clear archetype in the game for eight years; Yang's reload cost-cut makes the fan a machine gun.
Embodiment of the Marauder makes deployed Sentries FIRE YOUR OWN hatred spenders — the player places turrets that execute the player's kit; the 2.1 meta so dominant it forced a redesign.

proxy.note: turrets execute the player's skill — GX-19 flagship in D3

mech_summary: Shadow's Mantle turns Impale into a single-target execution profession — melee-range knife throws deleting elites while trash is someone else's job; THE Rift Guardian Killer role build.
Cooldown-looped Rain of Vengeance barrages under Natalya's reset engine — call the arrow storm, refresh it before it lands twice; UE's transition partner in current seasonal play.

Gears of Dreadlands converts the PRIMARY generator into the payload — Strafe auto-fires piercing Hungering Arrows while you never stop moving; the run-and-gun momentum archetype at the top of the speed meta.
Ring a colossal spirit BELL down onto packs — Sunwuko clones and stacks feed one-button bell drops; D3's bell predates PoE2's bell by a decade and the lineage note writes itself.
The S24 Inna rework summons the full mystic-ally menagerie at once — a fire-fist pet squad the monk buffs and detonates; D3's pet-class-that-isn't finally getting its army.

Mark everything with Exploding Palm, then Seven-Sided Strike DETONATES every mark in a teleporting blur — the genre's cleanest mark-then-mass-detonate loop, with corpse-chain explosions cascading through density.
Lightning-punch generator monk under Shenlong's spirit-dump rhythm — build spirit to the cap, the fist weapons ignite it into a damage window, drain, repeat; a breathing-cycle economy.
Tempest Rush spent six years as a dead skill until Patterns of Justice made channel-move-forever the whole build — a cyclone of wind you steer through the rift; the cleanest rebirth-by-set arc in D3.
Rathma compresses the ultimate — Army of the Dead on a rotation, a screen-swallowing skeletal tide every few seconds; S39's fourth cube slot made it the meta-warping co-king.

Masquerade of the Burning Carnival: two Simulacrum blood-clones MIRROR your Bone Spear casts — every throw is three throws; the player as conductor of self-copies, D2 bonemancer lineage via clone chorus.

proxy.note: simulacra execute the player's cast — GX-11

mech_summary: Death Nova paid for in LIFE under Trag'Oul's blood-magic doubler — every cast bleeds you, every heal is amplified, the health globe is a second mana bar; nova timing as blood budgeting.

Corpses become guided bone missiles — Land of the Dead makes EVERYTHING a corpse for twelve seconds and the lance machine-gun empties the graveyard into the boss; corpse economy at its purest, single-target role division.

econ.note: GX-04 flagship — LotD manufactures the resource

mech_summary: A swirling tornado of bone ORBITS the necromancer's body shredding whatever walks into it — melee-range necro living inside a personal cyclone; the body-orbit archetype in bone.
Zero-damage support necro — Frailty curse execution thresholds, globe generation, and group-wide Land of the Dead uptime; the trash-killer's force multiplier in the professionalized 4-player trinity.
Three angry cleaving Gargantuans do all the work while the doctor paints Wall of Death and keeps the pets fed — the genre's big-pet archetype, D3 chapter.
Carnevil makes your fetish swarm FIRE POISON DARTS every time YOU do — twenty-three tiny blowguns echoing the player's trigger finger; the swarm-mirrors-the-player archetype.

proxy.note: swarm executes the player's cast — GX-11 in swarm form

mech_summary: Stack Haunt and Locust Swarm DoTs, then Soul Harvest CONSUMES them — detonating years of future damage in one instant; the genre's cleanest DoT-then-cash-out loop.
Channel a cone of burning bats point-blank under Arachyr's spider-queen engine — melee-range channel doctor, the class's tankiest identity of its era.
Gazing Demise phantasms hover as ghostly turrets pulsing Spirit Barrage — the doctor deploys floating specters and the Manitou drains everything nearby; late-D3's WD push king.

Cooldown-reduction stacking until Summon Zombie Dogs hits ZERO cooldown — summon, SACRIFICE the pack for explosions, resummon instantly, forever; the summon-as-ammunition loop that defined vanilla's exploit-craft culture.

econ.note: GX-06-on-proxies + GX-04: minions manufactured to detonate

mech_summary: Ignite the target with fire to MARK it, then Combustion multiplies everything against the burning — apply the brand, execute the branded; S23's rework made mark-then-amplify the set's explicit grammar.
Tal Rasha DEMANDS element rotation — cycle fire, cold, lightning, arcane attacks to stack the meta-buff, then meteors cash the window in; a four-element metronome where the rotation IS the resource.

econ.note: GX-15 + timing-window economy — the rotation metronome as resource

mech_summary: Bank the ENTIRE Arcane Power pool plus Archon swap-buffs into one Star Pact meteor — a multi-step cast choreography the community named after ordnance; the one-shot as a rehearsed performance, currently co-holding the S39 ceiling.

Delsere slow-time bubbles trap packs while Ranslor's bracers make Energy Twisters VACUUM enemies into their wandering funnels — spawned hazards that gather their own victims; PoE2's Twister has a grandmother.

geo.note: wandering hazards that PULL — GX-09 family

mech_summary: Bank Chantodo's Wave stacks in caster form, then TRANSFORM into Archon — a complete replacement kit whose entrance detonates the banked wave; form-shift with a savings account, the classic transformation build by name in current lists.
A healing ring's forgotten proc becomes the whole build — lightning attacks roll Paralysis stuns, and every stun triggers Manald Heal's hidden damage; the item-proc-as-engine era classic.

econ.note: hook-layer: stun ailment AS the trigger

mech_summary: A garden of hydra heads doing the shooting while the wizard gardens — Typhon scales per-head, the LoD Mammoth variant rides one giant lava-river head; turret-caster identity, D3 chapter.

canonicity.longevity: 2.4 LoN→S17 LoD gem→ two GR150 S-tiers current

mech_summary: The ANTI-SET: a gem that pays you a massive multiplier for wearing NO set at all, scaling per ancient legendary — the escape valve D3 had to add so free recombination could compete with authored capstones; hosts Death Nova, Bazooka, Bombardment, WoL, Mammoth Hydra, Rapid Fire.
The knockback nova that never earned a set, a supporting legendary that mattered, or a leaderboard row — D3's reference setless-orphan skill; in an authored-capstone game, no author means no build.

Launch-era Roland's flagship whose resource cost and damage were nerfed into oblivion in 2.1 and NEVER rehabilitated across twelve years of patches — the killed-by-nerf negative class: not born bad, made dead and left dead.

econ.note: the cost WAS the kill mechanism

mech_summary: The lobbed-skull generator that no set, legendary, or meta ever wanted — a primary that stayed a leveling filler for a decade; the unclaimed-skill negative in a game where builds are assigned, not found.

The melee-range wizard generator that flirted with In-geom speed gimmicks but never held a push identity — a caster class's melee button nobody authored a home for; contrast the Monk generators that got Raiment.
